task: Find the latest model of the iPhone and compare the price and screen size between the pro and pro max.
answer:
FINAL: As of October 27, 2026, Apple’s latest Pro models are iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. On Apple’s U.S. store, iPhone 18 Pro starts at US$1,199 with a 6.3-inch display; iPhone 18 Pro Max starts at US$1,299 with a 6.9-inch display. The Pro Max costs US$100 more and has a display 0.6 inches larger diagonally.
Source: https://www.apple.com/shop/buy-iphone/iphone-18-pro (model options show both starting prices and display sizes). Latest-model evidence: https://www.apple.com/iphone-18-pro/ (listed as “New”). Screenshot: final.png.
